top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Trump's tariff leverage, EU warning and Iran hopes
top_signals.summary: The one place Washington's leverage is unambiguous is tariffs, where Congress just gave Trump a fresh weapon aimed at Beijing and New Delhi.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: RBA: Firms Starting to Ask If Inflation Coming Back Under 3%
top_signals.summary: Australian businesses are starting to “bubble up” a view that elevated inflation is not coming back down below 3%, Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Michele Bullock told a parliamentary panel on Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Chinese Yuan Hits Strongest Level Since 2022 After PBOC Fixing
top_signals.summary: The yuan climbed to its highest level against the dollar in more than four years, extending an advance underpinned by broad Chinese export strength and support from the central bank.
